content: Transfers between own accounts are explicitly excluded from budget/spending totals in mature apps (Actual Budget, Monarch) because they are not new spending, just money moving. Implementation pattern: a transfer creates two linked transactions (one debit, one credit) that reference each other; updating/deleting one propagates to the other. Credit card bill payments are treated as transfers (from checking to credit card liability account), not as a spending category, to avoid double counting the original purchases.
